package shop

fun clean(path: String) = "${path.removeSuffix("/*")}"

class Shop(private val name: String) {
    val label = "${name.replace("(", "[")} ${"""raw ${name.length}"""}"

    fun greet(items: List<String>): String {
        return "Hi ${items.joinToString("}") { it.trim() }}"
    }

    fun after() {
    }
}

fun top() {
}
